full_text:
Job Title: Full Stack Developer
Company: IPEX SOFT LTD
Career Level: Experienced
Experience Required: 2 - 5 years
Location: Manchester, United Kingdom
Workplace: Remote
Skills: JavaScript, Software Development, Computer Science, React.js, React Native, Next js, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, AWS, API, CSS, Design, Development, Engineering, Information Technology (IT), React
Description: IPEX SOFT is a UK-based software company looking for a talented Full-Stack Web & Mobile Developer to join us remotely. We are looking for a hands-on developer who can build complete web and mobile products - from understanding requirements and designing the solution to development, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. You will work across React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, APIs and databases , while also using modern AI development tools to accelerate delivery. What You'll Do Build modern web applications using React, Next.js and TypeScript. Develop cross-platform iOS and Android applications using React Native. Build secure back-end services and REST APIs using Node.js. Design and work with relational and NoSQL databases. Build authentication, authorisation and role-based access functionality. Integrate third-party APIs, payment services and external platforms. Integrate AI/LLM APIs into applications where appropriate. Build dashboards, customer portals, SaaS products and internal business applications. Take new ideas from prototype/MVP through to production. Use AI coding tools to accelerate development, debugging, testing and refactoring. Review and improve AI-generated code rather than accepting it blindly. Write clean, modular and maintainable production code. Debug front-end, back-end, mobile, database and deployment issues. Apply appropriate security, validation and error-handling practices. Work with Git/GitHub and participate in code reviews. Deploy and troubleshoot applications in cloud environments. Communicate progress and blockers clearly while working remotely. AI-Assisted Development AI-assisted development is an important part of this role. We want someone comfortable using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex or similar AI coding assistants to work faster and solve problems effectively. However, AI should enhance your engineering ability — not replace it. You must be able to understand the code you submit, identify incorrect or insecure AI-generated implementations, debug problems independently and explain the technical decisions behind your work. Experience integrating LLM APIs, AI agents, structured outputs, tool/function calling, RAG or AI-powered automation is a strong advantage. Remote Working This is a fully remote position for candidates based in Egypt , working with IPEX SOFT, a UK-based software company. You will be expected to maintain reliable availability during agreed working hours, attend scheduled online meetings, provide regular progress updates and communicate blockers promptly. We value quality, ownership, communication and measurable delivery rather than simply being online. Selection Process Shortlisted candidates will complete a small practical technical assessment before progressing to the technical interview. You may use AI development tools during the assessment. We are interested in how effectively you use them, but you must understand and be able to explain everything you submit. Successful candidates will then attend a technical interview focused primarily on their implementation, engineering decisions and previous real-world development experience.

Back End Node.js Express.js and/or Next.js server-side development REST API design and development Authentication and authorisation Role-based access control Input validation and error handling Third-party API integrations Databases PostgreSQL and/or MySQL MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases Database and schema design Data modelling and relationships SQL Indexing and query optimisation Experience with Prisma or another modern ORM is desirable. Engineering Fundamentals You should have a practical understanding of: Clean and maintainable code Modular software design Git and GitHub Debugging and testing Code reviews Application architecture API and database security Authentication and authorisation Data isolation Performance and scalability Secure handling of application secrets and user data You do not need to be a senior software architect, but you should be able to make sensible technical decisions and explain the trade-offs behind them. AI Development Skills You should be comfortable using modern AI development tools such as: Claude Code Codex GitHub Copilot Similar AI coding assistants Experience integrating AI/LLM APIs into real applications is highly desirable. Cloud & Deployment Experience with some of the following is desirable: AWS Vercel Supabase Firebase Docker CI/CD Linux Cloud databases Candidate Profile We're looking for someone who: Has built real applications beyond tutorials and coursework. Can show examples of projects they personally contributed to. Can take ownership of a feature from requirement to production. Is comfortable learning new technologies when a project requires them. Is interested in developing a long-term working relationship with IPEX SOFT. Description: About us: Jannah Integrated Solutions Ltd. is a UK-registered EdTech company. We run A* Quiz ( astarquiz.com ), a smart online platform for Class 9, IGCSE and AS-Level students built around generating quizzes for MCQs based exams with topic classification, instant grading, and adaptive quizzes. We currently support 15 Cambridge subjects across Class 9, IGCSE and AS-Level — including Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Combined Science, Economics, and Accounting. Our platform serves four account types: Schools (including tutoring centers), Teachers (including private tutors), Students, and Parents. We are now expanding into Egypt and looking for our first commercial hire to lead the market. About the role: You will own A* Quiz's entire Egypt market for our platform. This is a founding sales role with responsibility for FOUR customer segments: Cambridge IGCSE schools, tutoring centers, private tutors in the science / commerce subjects we support, and direct sign-ups by students and parents. You will work directly with the founder / representative. This role suits someone who has sold EdTech to the Cambridge ecosystem before and wants to build something from the ground up. What you will do: Build and own the Egypt sales pipeline across all 4 customer segments For calibration, the Year-1 plan asks for roughly 3 schools + 8 tutoring centres, 50 private tutors on paid Teacher plans, and 250 direct student/parent subscriptions in your first 6 months, all led directly by you — this is the plan full OTE is paid against (school closings track the academic-year budget cycle, so their timing depends on your start month). These are floors, not ceilings. Commission is per deal and uncapped across all four streams, plus a share of total Egypt ARR at year end — beating the plan pays you more, it does not just tick a box. Run product demos in person and online with school principals, centre owners, and private tutors — explicitly demonstrating MCQ workflow and analytics Build relationships with the Egyptian private tutor community via TeacherOn, Modarby, Ostazi, Mydrasa, Facebook tutor groups, and WhatsApp networks — targeting tutors of OUR LIVE SUBJECTS only Coordinate with a network of Egyptian UGC creators to produce promotional content Set up and run the company CRM to a defined data standard — every prospect, conversation and deal logged the same day — and report to the founder weekly against it Represent the brand at IGCSE-related events, fairs, and Cambridge gatherings After Month 6, recruit and lead a Junior BD Executive to scale private tutor acquisition (subject to performance gates) What we offer: Base salary: EGP 25,000 – 35,000 / month Monthly KPI bonus: EGP 10,000 when at least 70% of the monthly KPI plan is achieved (paid the following month) Uncapped commission across 4 revenue streams (schools, centres, tutors, B2C) — no ceiling on the number of tutors, centres, schools or subscribers you sign. Description: Accountant Job Summary We are looking for a competent, detail-oriented, and experienced Accountant to manage the company’s day-to-day accounting and financial activities. The Accountant will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, preparing financial statements and management reports, handling accounts payable and receivable, performing bank reconciliations, supporting taxation and audit activities, managing month-end and year-end closing, and ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards and company procedures. The ideal candidate should have strong practical accounting knowledge and be capable of independently handling the full accounting cycle and serving as a reliable point of contact for routine accounting and financial matters. Key Responsibilities Record, verify, allocate, post, and reconcile financial transactions. Maintain accurate books of accounts, journals, ledgers, and supporting schedules. Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable . Prepare supplier payments and monitor outstanding payables. Issue and record customer invoices and monitor outstanding receivables. Follow up on overdue accounts and maintain proper aging reports. Perform daily, weekly, and monthly bank reconciliations . Investigate and resolve differences between bank statements and accounting records. Maintain the general ledger and ensure all transactions are correctly classified. Prepare journal entries, accruals, prepayments, provisions, depreciation, and adjustments. Support and complete month-end and year-end closing activities. Prepare trial balances and supporting accounting schedules. Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements , including: Balance Sheet Income Statement / Profit and Loss Statement Cash Flow Statement Changes in Equity Supporting schedules and reconciliations Prepare management accounting reports and financial summaries. Analyze revenues, expenses, margins, costs, and variances. Monitor company expenses and identify unusual or unnecessary expenditure. Assist management with budgeting and financial forecasting. Prepare budget-versus-actual reports and explain significant variances. Assist with cash-flow planning and monitoring. Maintain fixed asset registers and calculate depreciation. Maintain schedules for loans, advances, deposits, accruals, provisions, and other balance-sheet accounts. Handle intercompany transactions and reconciliations where applicable. Prepare and maintain proper supporting documentation for all accounting transactions. Ensure proper filing and retention of invoices, vouchers, receipts, bank documents, contracts, and financial records. Taxation & Statutory Compliance Assist with preparation and submission of applicable tax returns and tax-related reports . Handle tax calculations, tax settlements, withholding taxes, VAT or other applicable indirect taxes where required. Maintain supporting documentation for tax filings. Reconcile tax accounts with accounting records. Coordinate with tax consultants and relevant authorities when required. Assist with tax audits, assessments, and regulatory inquiries. Ensure accounting records comply with applicable laws, regulations, and statutory requirements. Audit Responsibilities Prepare schedules and supporting documentation for internal and external audits . Liaise with auditors and respond to audit queries. Assist in resolving audit findings and implementing recommendations. Ensure proper financial documentation and controls are maintained throughout the year. Support management in maintaining audit-ready accounting records. Financial Controls & Procedures Follow and maintain established accounting policies and procedures. Assist in developing and improving accounting processes and internal controls. Identify accounting errors, weaknesses, or inefficiencies and recommend corrective actions. Ensure proper authorization and documentation of financial transactions. Support segregation of duties and other financial control procedures. Monitor compliance with company financial policies. Recommend improvements to accounting systems, reporting processes, and financial procedures. Banking & Treasury Support Prepare bank reconciliations and monitor bank balances. Prepare payment instructions and supporting documents. Maintain banking records and transaction schedules. Monitor cash availability and upcoming payment obligations. Assist with cash-flow forecasts. Coordinate with banks regarding routine banking transactions when required. Maintain records relating to bank charges, transfers, deposits, guarantees, and other banking transactions. Accounting Systems & Data Management Enter and maintain accounting information accurately in the company's accounting or ERP system. Ensure accounting system balances agree with supporting documentation. Maintain proper chart of accounts and transaction classifications. Assist with accounting system implementation, upgrades, or process improvements where required. Prepare financial data and reports using Excel and accounting software. Ensure financial data is properly backed up, organized, and accessible to authorized personnel. Required Accounting Knowledge The candidate should have strong knowledge and practical experience in: General accounting Bookkeeping General ledger accounting Accounts payable Accounts receivable Bank reconciliation Cash and bank management Journal entries Trial balance preparation Accruals and prepayments Provisions Fixed asset accounting Depreciation Revenue and expense recognition Financial statement preparation Month-end closing Year-end closing Tax accounting Tax settlement VAT and withholding tax, where applicable Budgeting Forecasting Cash-flow preparation Financial analysis Expense control Cost accounting fundamentals Audit preparation Internal controls Accounting policies and procedures Financial documentation and record keeping Balance-sheet reconciliations Supplier and customer reconciliations Intercompany reconciliations Payroll accounting fundamentals Inventory accounting fundamentals Foreign currency transactions and exchange differences, where applicable Financial reporting standards and accounting principles Accounting Standards The candidate should have a good working knowledge of: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) Applicable local accounting standards IFRS , where applicable Revenue recognition principles Expense recognition and matching principles Asset and liability classification Financial statement presentation Basic internal control and audit principles
Requirements: Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field . Professional accounting qualification such as ACCA, CMA, CPA, CA, CIMA, or equivalent is preferred. Relevant practical accounting experience. Previous experience with an international accounting firm or Big Four firm will be considered an advantage. Experience working in a commercial, trading, industrial, logistics, energy, engineering, or service business will be an advantage. Experience handling full-cycle accounting independently is strongly preferred. Microsoft Excel Skills Strong Microsoft Excel skills are essential, including practical knowledge of: VLOOKUP XLOOKUP HLOOKUP Pivot Tables INDEX and MATCH IFERROR Conditional formatting Data validation Sorting and filtering Text functions Date functions Reconciliation worksheets Financial schedules Data cleaning Basic charts and reporting Importing and organizing financial data The candidate should be comfortable working with large Excel files and using Excel to perform reconciliations, analysis, reporting, and financial calculations. Accounting Software & ERP Skills Experience with one or more accounting or ERP systems is preferred. Analytical Skills The Accountant should be able to: Analyze financial transactions and identify discrepancies. Reconcile multiple sources of financial information. Investigate unusual account balances. Identify accounting errors and correct them. Analyze costs and expenses. Understand financial trends. Prepare variance analysis. Interpret financial statements. Identify potential financial risks. Provide accurate financial information to management. Communication & Coordination Skills The candidate should have: Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to communicate financial information clearly. Ability to coordinate with management, employees, suppliers, customers, banks, auditors, consultants, and government authorities. Ability to respond professionally to accounting and financial queries. Ability to prepare clear financial reports and supporting explanations. Good English communication skills. Organizational Skills The candidate must be able to: Work independently with limited supervision. Manage multiple accounting tasks simultaneously. Prioritize work according to deadlines. Maintain organized accounting records. Meet monthly reporting deadlines. Handle confidential financial information responsibly. Maintain accurate documentation. Work under pressure during month-end, year-end, audit, and tax periods. Essential Requirements The candidate must have strong hands-on experience in: Bank reconciliation Accounts payable and accounts receivable General ledger accounting Financial statement preparation Tax calculation and tax settlement Month-end and year-end closing Audit preparation and coordination Advanced Microsoft Excel Accounting software or ERP systems Balance-sheet reconciliations Financial reporting Maintaining accurate accounting records and supporting documentation

title: Performance Marketing & Media Buying Lead
full_text:
Job Title: Performance Marketing & Media Buying Lead
Company: elbaraka 
Career Level: Senior Management
Experience Required: 4 - 8 years
Location: Nasr City, Cairo, Egypt
Workplace: On-site
Skills: Digital Marketing, Media Buying, Marketing, Social Media, E-Marketing
Description: Job Overview We are looking for a highly analytical and results-driven Performance Marketing & Media Buying Lead to own and lead the company's performance marketing and paid media function. This role is responsible for developing and executing the company's paid acquisition strategy, managing media budgets, optimizing campaign performance, driving customer acquisition and revenue growth, and providing data-driven recommendations to management. The role is a functional ownership position . The successful candidate will be the primary owner of performance marketing and media buying, working cross-functionally with Creative, Content, Sales, CRM, and other teams to deliver measurable business results. Location: Makram Ebeid Gender: Males ONLY Key Responsibilities 1. Performance Marketing Strategy Own the overall Performance Marketing & Paid Media strategy in alignment with company objectives. Develop customer acquisition strategies across the full marketing funnel. Define channel strategies across Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn , and other relevant advertising platforms. Identify opportunities to increase acquisition, revenue, and marketing efficiency. Develop short-term and long-term paid acquisition plans. Establish clear performance targets and KPIs for all paid media activities. Continuously evaluate new channels, audiences, technologies, and acquisition opportunities. 2. Media Buying & Campaign Management Own the planning, setup, launch, optimization, and scaling of paid advertising campaigns. Set up, launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads , and other platforms. Manage and optimize advertising accounts across relevant platforms. Develop audience targeting, segmentation, retargeting, and lookalike strategies. Manage campaign budgets and ensure efficient allocation of spend. Conduct continuous A/B testing across creatives, audiences, offers, placements, landing pages, and bidding strategies. Identify underperforming campaigns and implement corrective actions. Scale successful campaigns while maintaining target CPA, CAC, ROAS, and profitability. Ensure campaigns follow platform policies and best practices. 3. Budget & Business Performance Own the company's paid media budget and recommend allocation across channels and campaigns. Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly advertising spend. Forecast expected leads, customers, revenue, CAC, and ROAS based on budget allocation. Make data-driven decisions regarding increasing, reducing, or reallocating media spend. Ensure marketing investment generates measurable business value. Connect advertising performance with actual sales and revenue , rather than relying only on platform metrics. 4. Analytics & Performance Optimization Monitor and analyze key performance indicators including: ROAS ROI CAC CPA CPL CTR CPC CPM Conversion Rate Revenue Customer Acquisition Cost Identify performance trends, opportunities, and issues. Build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting frameworks. Analyze campaign, audience, creative, and funnel performance. Turn data into actionable recommendations for business growth. Develop a structured testing and optimization framework. 5. Tracking & Attribution Ensure accurate tracking and attribution across all paid media channels. Manage and monitor: GA4 Google Tag Manager Meta Pixel Meta Conversion API Google Ads conversion tracking UTM tracking Other relevant analytics and attribution tools Work with technical teams when tracking or attribution issues arise. Ensure campaign data is reliable enough to support business decisions. 6. Creative & Funnel Collaboration Work closely with the Creative and Content teams to develop high-performing advertising concepts. Translate performance data into clear creative recommendations. Identify which messages, offers, formats, and creatives drive the strongest results. Collaborate on landing-page and conversion-rate optimization. Work with Sales and CRM teams to understand lead quality, customer conversion, and revenue performance. Ensure the complete acquisition funnel is continuously optimized. 7. Reporting & Management Provide regular performance reports to company management. Present campaign results, key insights, challenges, and growth opportunities. Provide recommendations for budget allocation and future marketing strategy. Develop monthly and quarterly performance forecasts. Take ownership of performance outcomes and communicate risks and opportunities proactively. Support management in making strategic decisions related to customer acquisition and marketing investment. 8. Market & Competitor Analysis Monitor competitors' advertising activities, offers, messaging, and acquisition strategies. Stay up to date with changes in advertising platforms and industry trends. Research new media channels, tools, technologies, and growth opportunities. Identify opportunities to gain a competitive advantage through paid acquisition. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The role will primarily be measured against business and performance outcomes, including: Revenue generated through paid media ROAS / ROI Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) Cost per Acquisition (CPA) Cost per Lead (CPL) Conversion Rate Qualified lead volume and quality Marketing budget efficiency Growth in customer acquisition Scalability of paid campaigns Contribution of paid media to overall company growth Location: Makram Ebeid Gender: Males ONLY
Requirements: 4-6 years of experience in Performance Marketing, Paid Media, or Media Buying . Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads . Experience managing and scaling paid advertising campaigns. Strong understanding of performance marketing funnels and customer acquisition. Proven experience managing significant advertising budgets. Strong analytical and data interpretation skills. Experience with campaign testing, optimization, and scaling. Strong understanding of attribution, conversion tracking, and marketing analytics. Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and Conversion API. Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills. Ability to connect media performance with actual sales and revenue. Strong communication and presentation skills. Ability to work independently and take full ownership of the function. Strong commercial mindset with a focus on measurable business results. Leadership Profile The ideal candidate is someone who can lead from both a strategic and technical perspective — not simply manage people. You should be able to: Set the performance strategy. Challenge and guide media buyers. Review and improve campaign strategies. Make data-driven budget decisions. Identify why performance is improving or declining. Coach team members and raise their performance level. Communicate results and recommendations clearly to senior management. Take ownership of the team's overall business results.

Retail Campaigns, Activations & Customer Engagement Lead the development and execution of high-impact retail campaigns across the full customer journey. Continuously evaluate campaign effectiveness and optimize future initiatives based on data, customer insights, and commercial results. 4. Store Traffic & Customer Acquisition Develop strategic initiatives to increase store footfall and customer acquisition across the retail network. Lead local store marketing strategies based on location, customer demographics, market potential, and competitive landscape. Identify opportunities to attract new customer segments and increase customer frequency and engagement. Partner with Digital Marketing, CRM, and E-Commerce teams to create integrated customer acquisition and retention initiatives. Establish clear measurement frameworks to evaluate Marketing ROI and commercial impact . Optimize marketing expenditure based on campaign performance, customer response, store performance, and business priorities. Ensure marketing resources are directed toward initiatives with the strongest potential for sustainable growth. 7. Brand Presence & Retail Experience Strengthen and maintain a distinctive and consistent brand presence across all physical customer touchpoints. Partner closely with Visual Merchandising to ensure strong execution of brand identity, collection stories, campaigns, window displays, store layouts, POS materials, and in-store communication. Ensure marketing campaigns are translated into compelling and commercially effective retail experiences. Continuously enhance the customer journey and physical brand experience across the retail network. 8. New Store Openings & Retail Expansion Support the company's retail expansion strategy through market intelligence, customer analysis, and location-specific marketing insights. Develop comprehensive marketing strategies for new store openings , including pre-launch awareness, launch activations, and post-opening customer acquisition. Assess market potential, customer profiles, competitive activity, and commercial opportunities in new locations. Support market entry and brand-building strategies across international markets. 9. Omnichannel & Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with E-Commerce and Digital Marketing leadership to create seamless online-to-offline and offline-to-online customer journeys . Collaborate with Merchandising to align marketing activities with collections, product launches, product priorities, and commercial objectives. Partner with Retail, Operations, Supply Chain, CRM, Finance, and Business Analysis teams to ensure effective execution and measurable results. Work closely with Visual Merchandising to ensure seamless integration between marketing campaigns and the physical retail environment. Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to deliver complex, multi-channel initiatives successfully. 10. Market Intelligence & Competitive Strategy Maintain a deep understanding of the Egyptian and international fashion retail markets . Monitor consumer behavior, market trends, competitor activities, pricing strategies, promotional activities, and emerging retail trends. Identify new commercial opportunities and emerging customer segments. Translate market intelligence and consumer insights into actionable marketing and growth strategies. Ensure the brand remains relevant, competitive, and differentiated across local and international markets. 11. Leadership & Team Development Lead, inspire, and develop the Offline Marketing team to achieve ambitious business and marketing objectives. Establish clear objectives, KPIs, performance standards, and development plans. Build a high-performance culture focused on creativity, accountability, commercial impact, and continuous improvement . Develop the team's capabilities across retail marketing, campaign management, activations, customer insights, and performance marketing analysis. Foster strong collaboration between Marketing, Retail, Digital, E-Commerce, Merchandising, and other commercial functions.

Strong experience in both the Egyptian and international / regional markets is highly preferred. MBA / Master's degree is preferred. Strong commercial mindset with solid understanding of Retail KPIs, customer acquisition, and Marketing ROI . Excellent leadership, communication, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills. Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities.

full_text:
Job Title: Customer Service Clerk
Career Level: Experienced
Experience Required: 3 - 7 years
Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Workplace: Remote
Skills: Customer Service, Customer Support, Customer Care, Sales, Whats'app, Microsoft Excel
Description: About Bubbl Bubbl provides subscription car washing and interior cleaning inside residential and commercial buildings in Dubai. Our teams work in the parking floors, so our customers never have to leave their building. Everything we do runs on being reliable, tidy and easy to deal with — and our WhatsApp line is where most customers experience that. The Role You will be the voice of Bubbl on WhatsApp. This is not a call centre job — there are no phone calls. You will manage our WhatsApp inbox throughout the day, coordinating between customers and our on-site cleaning teams, keeping records, and passing the right things to the right people. The message volume is light to moderate. What matters most is that you are present, responsive and accurate during your hours. Schedule 6 days per week, with Saturday off 09:30–17:00 and 20:00–22:30 UAE time (GST, UTC+4), with a break in between You must be able to work these hours consistently from your own time zone Workload — What a Typical Day Looks Like This is an availability role rather than a high-volume one. The numbers below are indicative and vary day to day — some days there is a single interior clean, others there are ten. Time (UAE) Approx. volume What you are handling 09:30 – 11:00: Up to 3 customers/hour Busiest window — interior clean alerts plus general customer requests 11:00 – 14:00: Around 2 customers/hour Ongoing interior communications and incoming requests 14:00 – 17:00: Around 1 customer/hour Interior communications, follow-ups and logging 20:00 – 22:30: Up to 6 interiors Evening shift — interior clean communications only In practice that is roughly 15 to 20 customer conversations across the day, each one short. Quiet stretches are normal. What we are paying for is that when a message arrives, it is answered quickly and well. What You'll Do Message customers when our team arrives at their vehicle for an interior clean, and ask them to unlock it Confirm when the clean is complete and ask the customer to lock the vehicle Inform operations if access cannot be arranged or customer is unresponsive Always be polite throughout every interaction Share promotional offers as necessary to the respective customers Receive customer requests, questions and feedback over WhatsApp and respond clearly and professionally Log every request accurately for management review at the end of the day Dispatch specific operational requests to the on-site team via WhatsApp — rescheduling, missed spots, additional service requests Escalate defined situations to management immediately (see below) Maximum response time of 5 minutes Important Notes This is a fully remote, work-from-home role. No relocation, and no UAE visa or sponsorship is provided. You will be engaged as an independent contractor and are responsible for your own taxes and local compliance. No equipment is provided — you must have your own computer and internet connection.
Requirements: Requirements Fluent written English — clear, polite, correct grammar and a warm professional tone Previous customer service experience (required): support, hospitality, BPO, admin or similar Computer literate — confident with WhatsApp Web, Excel and browser-based tools Your own computer, and a stable, reliable internet connection Reliable, organised, and comfortable working independently without supervision Able to commit to UAE time zone hours, 6 days a week
